evals.prompt: Implement wp-02-delivery-adapters, which is at status: ready.
evals.expected_output: Transitions ready → executing, reads register/severity/owned_files/goal/checklist, resolves one dispatch via goalforge-pick-agent.py --role implement (model+effort explicit, blast radius forces high tier), dispatches one in-session brief with no brief/task files, runs goal.verification.command plus lint/typecheck, makes exactly one conventional commit, ticks the checklist, transitions implemented. Never writes status: verified.
expectations: SKILL.md drives ready → executing → implemented; verified is written only by goalforge-verify
SKILL.md status advance goes through the single writer, never hand-edited
SKILL.md dispatch resolved via goalforge-pick-agent.py --role implement, brief states model+effort explicitly
SKILL.md one WP commit, exactly one, staged only inside owned_files:
SKILL.md commit emits commit.linked with its sha

evals.prompt: The WP has 9 owned_files. How does execute dispatch it?
evals.expected_output: One agent owns the whole WP by default; split into batches only when owned_files holds more than 8 entries, or checklist items have pairwise disjoint {files:} sets AND the WP is parallel: true. Batches run concurrently, return DATA, and never commit — the one WP commit is execute's own (step 6).
expectations: SKILL.md one agent owns the whole WP by default
SKILL.md split condition: more than 8 owned_files, or disjoint {files:} AND parallel: true
SKILL.md batches never commit — the one WP commit is execute's

evals.prompt: The dispatched agent hits attempts >= 2 on the same checklist item — what happens?
evals.expected_output: STOP rule fires. Append the reason to findings.md, emit finding.recorded, leave status: executing, and escalate to the human — under SDD_AUTONOMY=unattended, park and exit cleanly instead. Status is never advanced past a blocker.
expectations: SKILL.md stop rule: attempts >= 2 on the same checklist item
SKILL.md on stop, append reason to findings.md and emit finding.recorded
SKILL.md a status is never advanced past a blocker

evals.prompt: A dispatched agent reports the referenced function doesn't exist in the codebase.
evals.expected_output: A premise-blocked return: naming the exact file:line and the unmet premise — a first-class success outcome, not a failure to route around.
expectations: SKILL.md premise check names an unmet premise as a first-class BLOCKED return
SKILL.md a needed edit outside the owned set is also a BLOCKED return, never a scope widening

evals.prompt: Verify the diff for wp-02 and decide if it's ready to ship.
evals.expected_output: goalforge-execute should NOT trigger — reviewing/judging an implemented WP's diff is goalforge-verify's job (implemented → verified), not execute's.
expectations: SKILL.md never writes status: verified — that edge belongs to goalforge-verify
Diff review/judging is outside the trigger surface of goalforge-execute
